description: Two-page German invoice (Rechnung) for laboratory supplies with German number format (1.234,56 €), a credit line with a leading hyphen-minus (-150,00), dd.mm.yyyy dates, a logo made of filled rectangles and a Code 39 barcode. Produced with fpdf2 2.9.0 using the non-embedded core fonts Helvetica/Helvetica-Bold (cp1252/WinAnsi); the line-item table is drawn cell by cell with zebra shading, and its header row is repeated on page 2 below a running header. Edits: one line item inserted as position 7, the quantity of 'Nitrilhandschuhe Gr. M' raised from 10 to 12 (its line amount changes), the return credit changed from -150,00 to -185,00, the due date moved; net, VAT and gross totals are recomputed. Consequences that are not listed: positions 7-35 renumber to 8-36, the zebra shading of every row after the insertion flips, the last row of page 1 (Laborthermometer) moves to the top of page 2, and everything on page 2 shifts down by one row. The page count stays 2 ('Seite 1 von 2').
